# Finding a Place to Live

Finding an apartment in Dallas is fairly straightforward, but where you choose to live has the biggest impact on your commute, budget, and lifestyle. The neighborhoods below are among the most popular choices for PMGers and provide a good starting point for your apartment search.

## Popular Neighborhoods

Whether you're looking for a walkable urban lifestyle or a quieter neighborhood with a shorter rent payment, Dallas has options for every preference.

## Suburban Options

If you're comfortable with a longer commute, the suburbs offer lower rent, larger apartments, and plenty of dining, shopping, and entertainment. Many PMGers choose these areas to maximize space and value while staying within a reasonable drive of the Uptown office.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Rule of Thumb

The closer you live to Uptown and McKinney Avenue, the higher the rent—but the easier the commute. Richardson, Plano, Frisco, and Addison generally offer more space for the money, but you'll spend more time driving each day.
:::
